note: Zone of the B25 orientation room (R_abs_space_02): the telescope balcony (Le balcon) outside its French windows, camera on the balcony facing the sea. Pale flagstones, navy wrought-iron railing, white geraniums, two brass telescopes; landmark: the white lantern column at the corner; view over slate and tile roofs to the wide sea. Adults and animals only, nobody on the railing. Feminine LEFT: canary in a gold bird cage on its stand (cage); squirrel hiding coins in a flower pot (cachette); cat and dog pressed close together on the bench (proximité); sunbather getting a tan on a deckchair facing the wide sea (étendue). Masculine RIGHT: lady painter whose canvas shows us only its plain back (revers); neighbour waving from the next-door balcony (voisinage). Exit: open French windows near left -> orientation room R_abs_space_02. Painted 2026-10-22 (track s08p3).
